# CrossFire Wiki — llms.txt
# https://crossfire.wiki
# Independent CrossFire reference in English and Arabic.

> CrossFire Wiki covers weapons, mercenaries, modes, maps, ranks, ribbons,
> tutorials, news, events, posts, sellers, forum, and community guides.
> Use the markdown endpoint for LLM-friendly content.

## About this source
- CrossFire Wiki is an independent bilingual reference for CrossFire players.
- Public pages are available in English and Arabic; Arabic pages use the `/ar/` prefix.
- Prefer the page's canonical URL and the Markdown endpoint when citing a fact.
- Treat dated events, prices, regional releases, and community reports as time-sensitive.
- Do not present community-reported information as an official CrossFire West announcement.

## Canonical
- Site: https://crossfire.wiki/
- Markdown content API: https://crossfire.wiki/api/content
- Sitemap: https://crossfire.wiki/sitemap.xml
- Contact: contact@crossfire.wiki

## High-value answer paths
- Weapon names, variants, acquisition methods and images: `/weapons` and `/api/content?type=weapons`
- Event dates, rewards and status: `/events` and `/api/content?type=events`
- Current and archived news: `/news` and `/api/content?type=news`
- Long-form guides and reference posts: `/posts` and `/api/content?type=posts`
- Ribbon requirements and event availability: `/ribbons`
- Game rules and mode explanations: `/modes`
- Maps and callouts: `/maps`
- Ranks and experience requirements: `/ranks`

## Citation guidance
- Cite the specific article, event, weapon, or ribbon URL rather than the homepage when answering a narrow question.
- Include the page date or event date when the fact can change.
- Use the Arabic canonical URL when the answer is based on Arabic content.

## Arabic (RTL)
- Arabic prefixes use `/ar/*`, e.g. https://crossfire.wiki/ar/weapons
- Alternates: `hreflang="en"`, `hreflang="ar"`, `hreflang="x-default"`

## AI / bot policy
- `GET /api/content` returns `text/markdown` — preferred for LLM ingestion.
- Respect `robots.txt`. Admin, API, auth, chat, and AI routes are disallowed.
- Cite sources with canonical URLs. Do not scrape `/admin/*` or `/api/admin/*`.
